senses.gloss: गत- + अध्वन् गत- + अध्वन् (vb. गम्), adj. versed, skilled, MBh. 12, 11876.
गत- + अन्त गत- + अन्त, adj. whose end is near, Rām. 2, 12, 31.
गत- + असु गत- + असु (vb. गम्), adj. lifeless, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 266.
गत- + आगति गत- + आगति, f. literally, coming and going, i. e. origin and disappearance, Rām. 2, 110, 1.
गत- + आयुस् गत- + आयुस्, adj. 1. lifeless, Pañc. 101, 23. 2. whose life is forfeited, Rām. 6, 1, 10.
गात्र- + आवरण गात्र- + आवरण, n. a shield, MBh. 7, 79.
गत- + आशङ्क गत- + आशङ्क and नष्ट-, adj., f. का, fearless.
गति- + उत्कम्प गति- + उत्कम्प, m. haste, Megh. 68.
गत- + क्लम गत- + क्लम, adj. f. मा, recreated, Nal. 11, 1.

गतागत गतागत, i. e. गत-आ-गत (vb. गम्), n.
 1. Going and coming, Kathās. 3, 69.
 2. The flight of a bird backward and forward, MBh. 8, 1902.

गति गति, i. e. गम् + ति, f.
 1. Going, Yājñ. 3, 170.
 2. Motion, Yājñ. 1, 250; Rām. 2, 60, 12.
 3. Course, Rām. 1, 3, 2.
 4. Flight, Rām. 5, 76, 7.
 5. The transmigration of the souls, Man. 6, 61.
 6. Gait, Man. 2, 199.
 7. Attainment, Bhag. 2, 43.
 8. Way, Brāhmaṇ, 1, 35; with परा, The last way, i. e. death, Brāhmaṇ. 2, 22.
 9. A means of success, Kathās. 18, 89.
 10. A stratagem, Rām. 6, 92, 6.
 11. Refuge, Man. 8, 84 (का गतिस्, in dramas, ‘how can it be helped ?’)
 12. Condition, Bhag. 4, 17.
 13. Happiness, MBh. 3, 17389.
 14. Basis, Man. 1, 110.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. βάσις.

गतिमन्त् गति-मन्त्, adj., f. मती.
 1. Having the power of motion, Hariv. 11794.
 2. Fistulous, Suśr. 2, 7, 2.
गातु गा + तु (ved.), m. Motion, course (of life), Chr. 297, 16 = Rigv. i. 112, 16.
† गात्र् गात्र्, i. 10, Par. To loosen.

गात्र गा + त्र, n.
 1. A limb, Man. 2, 209.
 2. The body, Man. 4, 122.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. βάθρον, although of different signification.
गात्रक गात्र + क, n. The body, Vikr. d. 79.
गात्ररुह गात्र-रुह, n. The hair of the body, Bhāg. P. 2, 3, 24.
गत- + ज्वर गत- + ज्वर, adj., f. रा, without sorrow, Rām. 6, 98, 7.
गत- + प्राण गत- + प्राण, adj. dead.
गति- + भेद गति- + भेद, m. going with great strides, Śāk. 93, 12.
गात्र- + यष्टि गात्र- + यष्टि, m. a delicate body; when latter part of comp. adj., the [] fem. ends in t, Ṛt. 6, 24.
गत- + वयस् गत- + वयस्, adj. old, Pañc. i. d. 11.
गत- + संज्ञ गत- + संज्ञ, adj. bereft of sense, Indr. 5, 21.
गत- + सत्त्व गत- + सत्त्व (vb. गम्), adj. lifeless, Nal. 16, 30.
